paragraphs.text:
As you kneel beside the dying man, his hand shoots up and 
grips  your  jacket  collar.  “Beware,”  he  rasps.  “Little Indians… 
Gray men. Up there… They got Jake… Oh, God…”

His fingers loosen and his arm drops to the ground. He has 
stopped breathing.
To follow his blood trail, go to 498. To turn back, go to 20.
